prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 版本更新日志（中英混排） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "版本" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 43px
  col 2: header "日期" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "类型" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "变更内容" · longest unbreakable word 90px · one-line width 646px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录各版本的发布日期、更新类型和具体变更，帮助读者了解产品演进。","reading":"读者可按版本或日期定位记录，再通过类型筛选，最后阅读变更内容；每一行应清楚地作为一条更新记录。","groups":["版本与日期共同标识更新记录，便于按时间查找。","类型与变更内容共同说明更新的性质及细节，其中类型适合纵向扫描，变更内容适合逐行阅读。"],"keep_intact":["版本号和日期","WebSocket、OAuth 2.0、GitHub、Google、i18n、OpenSSL、CVE-2024-0727 等技术名称和标识符","问题编号及性能数值"],"may_wrap":["变更内容可在中文词句和中英文词组之间自然换行。","类型中的“新功能”可在空间紧张时换行；该行的变更内容本身较长，预计已有换行高度可容纳它。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [64, 108, 51, 496] · table 720×322px · row heights [60, 60, 83, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [64, 108, 67, 480] · table 720×229px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [80, 120, 100, 419] · table 720×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"版本号和日期完整，变更内容列宽充裕，技术标识符没有被拆开。","problems":"类型表头和每个类型值都竖向换行，破坏纵向扫描；“新功能”占三行，使整行过高，表格节奏松散。","cause":"类型列宽51px，扣除21px内边距与边框后仅剩30px，容不下两个汉字；过多宽度因此留给了变更内容列。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"四个表头和类型值均保持完整，版本、日期易于纵向查找；变更内容获得较大空间，行高也较紧凑。","problems":"性能更新的第二行只有“现。”，形成很短的尾行，削弱该记录的阅读节奏。","cause":"变更内容列宽480px，正文恰好在“实现”中间换行；类型列宽67px已基本贴合最长类型，其他标识列也较紧凑，调整余地有限。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"表头、类型和标识列都有充足空间，列间层次清楚，技术标识符保持完整。","problems":"版本、日期和类型列的额外空白压缩了正文；首条更新因此把问题编号单独推到第二行，且性能更新也需要两行。","cause":"前三列合计300px，比r0B多61px，导致变更内容列缩至419px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r1-balanced","widths":[64,108,66,481],"change":"以r0B为基础，将类型列收窄1px、正文加宽1px，保持三字类型和表头完整，测试性能更新的短尾行是否能消除。"},{"name":"r1-rhythm","widths":[64,108,66,465],"change":"保留紧凑而完整的标识列与类型列，将正文稍微收窄，测试能否让性能更新的末行容纳更多文字，改善换行节奏；总宽703px。"}]}
